meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Blink Nova
journal.description: Scrollsage Iku gathers arcane power and teleports to the location of a player, inflicting 750066 Arcane damage to all players. Players farther from Scrollsage Iku's target receive less damage.

journal.title: Dark Whispers
journal.description: Mor'zahi's dark whispers compel the target to follow his commands.

journal.title: Evil Eyes
journal.description: The statues within the chamber project spirit flames at players, inflicting 416703 Shadow damage to players within 3 yds of the impact locations.

journal.title: Final Ascension
journal.description: Mor'zahi gathers power slowly for his final ascension. Upon channeling, he inflicts 208352 Shadow damage every 1 sec to all players.

journal.title: Frostfire Volley
journal.description:
While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Scrollsage Iku unleashes a volley of elemental missiles at several targets, inflicting 125011 Fire or Frost damage to players within 10 yds of the targets and afflicting them with Burning Flames or Piercing Frost.

Each missile leaves behind a patch of elemental ground at its impact location.

These impacts trigger Elemental Explosion if they strike any player afflicted by Burning Flames or Piercing Frost.

journal.title: Mor'zahi's Command
journal.description: Mor'zahi violently retakes control of his target, granting them additional abilities.

journal.title: Shell Spin
journal.description: First Mate Nama hurls three spinning shells in a cone in front of him. The shells will stun players they come into contact with for 4 sec.

journal.title: Shredding Shards
journal.description:
Scrollsage Iku projects a series of ice shards at her current target, inflicting 83341 Frost damage every 0.5 sec for 3.5 sec.

Each shard increases the target's damage taken from Shredding Shards by 50% for 1.3 min.

journal.title: Throw Junk
journal.description: While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, Trader Gebbo throws crates from his inventory which inflict 1000088 Physical damage to players within 3 yds of their impact locations. Stepping on a crate breaks it, inflicting Splinters.

journal.title: Mighty Thud
journal.description:
While under the effects of Mor'zahi's Command, First Mate Nama marks three players then leaps to each of their locations.

Each impact inflicts 5417143 Physical damage split evenly among players within 6 yds and knocks them back.

If Mighty Thud fails to hit a player, it inflicts 5417143 Physical damage to all players.

journal.title: Bounce
journal.description: A Bouncy Mushroom bounces a player high into the air.

journal.title: Mushroom Toss
journal.description: Trader Gebbo tosses Bouncy Mushrooms at players' locations. Bouncy Mushrooms bounce players high into the air when touched.

journal.title: Explosive Surprise
journal.description: Trader Gebbo tosses a bomb to the location of a player which inflicts 833407 Physical damage to players within 10 yds on impact.

journal.title: Relic Rupture
journal.description: The relic within the crate ruptures with necrotic energy if left untouched after 25 sec, inflicting 2500220 Shadow damage to all players.

journal.title: Smashing Shovel
journal.description: When one of his allies is defeated, Trader Gebbo wields a shovel which inflicts an additional 416703 Physical damage and knocks players back with each strike.

journal.title: Relentless Escalation
journal.description: When one of his allies is defeated, First Mate Nama gains 100% increased damage every 1 sec for 30 sec.

journal.title: Icebound Flames
journal.description: Scrollsage Iku blasts a player with elemental magic, inflicting 833407 Frostfire damage along with 166681 Frostfire damage every 1 sec while reducing their movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

journal.title: Cataclysmic Invocation
journal.description: When one of her allies is defeated, Scrollsage Iku unleashes a massive explosion, inflicting 1166769 Fire damage to all players. This damage increases with each cast.
